area: UI / HUD: kanji inventory, Nindō HUD (bandana + dragon with Filo de Ira folded in), menus and panels redesign
summary:
Baseline: HEAD aba4a94. Your commit b656970 ("HUD vivo y sin kanji") already took every kanji off the screen and removed the orange rage bar. Running a CJK regex over Scripts/**/*.cs now only finds code comments, plus the non-Japanese glyphs □○△▼. The inventory below gives the original file:line for each kanji, its status and its replacement.

What still needs fixing, measured against b656970:

(1) The way Filo de Ira is folded into the dragon loses information:
- Rage "heat" is drawn inside the gold spirit fill, growing from the head. When spirit is low it simply can't be seen.
- While Filo de Ira is active, `heat` is forced to 1 (UIManager.HUD.cs:172), so the player gets no readout of time left, even though the design doc's "extend by hitting" mechanic depends on it.

(2) The dragon shader has three problems:
- The wave travels from tail to head (`phase = kx - wt`), so the dragon looks like it swims backwards. The shader's own comment says head to tail.
- The widest wave is at the head, so the horns, the separate eye Image and the mouth embers drift by about 4–5 px.
- The sprite has only 2.4% vertical padding against up to 6.7% displacement, so the horns and the whole rage aura get cut flat at the top of the quad. Confirmed in the lead's own hud_rage.png capture.

(3) The bandana knot is stretched 1.40x horizontally (a 1476x339 sprite drawn at 560x92).

(4) The HUD and the "[E] Rezar en el santuario" prompt show through the ending screen (ending_credits.png). Ending() clears InCutscene before ShowEnding, and the HUD only checks InCutscene.

(5) The lock-on reticle sits on the enemy's torso. At combat distance it covers 50–77% of a ninja's projected height, hiding the very wind-up the player needs to read for parry.

(6) Boss posture is never shown: bosses are excluded from the enemy widgets, and the boss bar shows HP only.

(7) The selected menu button is invisible. Computed luma: selected 0.076 vs normal 0.087, so selected is actually darker.

(8) The team's own brush logo (Sprites/Logo.jpg) is unused, and NindoContent.logo is {fileID: 0}.

(9) Every panel is still a flat rectangle: dialogue, tutorial, area title, pause, options, death, ending, toasts and boss bar.

Proposed design, "Tinta y Bandana", built only from the team's own visual language (thick black outline with flat fill, dry-brush logo, bandana red and dragon gold):
- **Dragon:** the dragon's back (dorsal crest) heats up like embers from tail to head as rage builds, separate from the gold spirit body. Flame tongues appear at 85% or more. When Filo de Ira is active the dragon burns, and the flames shrink back toward the tail as time runs out, using `Rage01`, which already drains with rageTimer. This was checked in a numpy emulation of the shader.
- **Panels:** brush, ink and ribbon panels, keycap prompts, pictogram stamps instead of kanji, and the boss bar drawn as an ink stroke with posture pips.
- **Prototypes:** a procedural PIL kit (31 textures with sizes and 9-slice borders) and six 1920x1080 mockups composited over real game screenshots.

issues.title: Filo de Ira folded into the dragon loses information: invisible at low spirit, no time-left while active
issues.evidence: NindoUISpirit.shader (fill pass): `heat = smoothstep(1-_Heat*1.02, 1.12-_Heat, x)*_Heat` tints only pixels inside the gold fill, from the head. With Spirit 25% / Rage 90% the heat is almost invisible: the frame gets only a +0.25*_Heat tint, which reads as 'whole dragon reddish' (emulation dragon_inprogress.png row 3). With Spirit 80% / Rage 40% it reads as 'the spirit edge is orange' (row 4, and the lead's own zoom_hud_heat.png). UIManager.HUD.cs:172 `float heat = p.RageActive ? 1f : p.Rage01;` makes heat constant while active, so the 9 s duration (PlayerConfig.rageDuration) and +0.6 s per hit extension (rageExtendOnHit) have no readout. Emulation rows 7-8 (100% vs 35% left) look identical. Rest state: eye alpha 0 below heat 0.15 (HUD.cs:188), so the dragon has no eye at all.
issues.fix: Rage lives on the dragon's BACK, independent of the spirit fill (proven in dragon_proposed.png / zoom_mock_hud.png). In both passes compute a dorsal rim: `above = tex2D(_MainTex, uv + float2(0, 0.045)).a; rim = tex.a*(1-above)` (0.045 = 0.06 of the old height, after re-padding). Gate it with `gate = smoothstep(-0.02, 0, _RageFront - x)`, where _RageFront = p.Rage01. PlayerController.TickRage already drains Rage01 with the timer, so the same value is fill progress AND time left. Frame rim colour ember (1.0,0.42,0.08)*1.15, fill rim crimson (0.95,0.16,0.04)*1.15. glow = 0.85, or 0.55+0.45*sin(T*3.2) when Rage01 >= 0.85. Flame aura only when _Ready (Rage01 >= 0.85: reach 0.07 uv, intensity 0.6) or active (reach 0.15, intensity 1), gated by `gate`. Remove the head-heat tint from the fill. Active: frame body ember tint 0.8 inside the gate and 0.35 outside, gold fill turns to fire (existing). Always-on ink pupil + gold glint at DragonEye that blinks every 4-7 s (0.12 s); the fire glow sits on top at Rage01 >= 0.85 or when active.

issues.title: HUD and world prompts bleed through ending, death and pause screens
issues.evidence: ending_credits.png shows the bandana, dragon, seals, objective and '[E] Rezar en el santuario' through the 95% black end panel. StoryDirector.Ending() runs `yield return Cutscene(EndingScene())`, which sets InCutscene=false, then calls ShowEnding(). UIManager.HUD.cs:128 hides the HUD only on Game.InCutscene. UIManager.UpdateWorldMarkers hides only on InCutscene || IsPaused. The pause overlay at 0.82 alpha and the death panel also leave the HUD visible underneath.
issues.fix: `bool hideHud = Game.InCutscene || PauseOpen || deathPanel.activeSelf || endPanel.activeSelf || DialogueOpen;` Use it to fade hudGroup to 0 at dt*4, and `world.gameObject.SetActive(!hideHud)`. The death screen may keep the bandana visible for 0.5 s, then fade.

issues.title: Lock-on reticle covers the enemy's torso and hides its attack wind-up (parry readability)
issues.evidence: UIManager.cs:119-123 and 216-221: a 46x46 gold diamond rotated 45° (65 px diagonal) is placed at Enemy.AimPoint = position + up*height*0.55 (torso). It pulses ±8% and spins 30°/s. Camera combat distance is 18-28 m, pitch 47°, FOV 30. That gives 112-72 px/m, and a 1.7 m ninja projects to 1.7*cos47 = 1.16 m = 130-84 px tall. So the reticle covers 50-77% of the body's projected height, right where the anticipation of the swing happens. This directly feeds the user's complaint ('no sabe cuándo el enemigo ataca').
issues.fix: Remove the torso reticle. Use a gold Kunai chevron (Kunai sprite rotated -90, 22x62 px) pointing down, anchored 70 px above the enemy HP widget. It pops in with scale 0.6->1.1->1.0 over 0.15 s, bobs ±4 px at 2 Hz and never spins. Optionally add a thin gold ring under the feet via CombatTelegraphs (world space), which never hides the body. Keep the rule: no UI element may overlap the projected bbox of an engaged enemy.

issues.title: Boss posture (imbalance) is never shown
issues.evidence: UIManager.cs:188, 192, 299 exclude `e is Boss` from widgets and PulseImbalance. The boss bar (BuildBossBar/UpdateBossBar) shows only HP, plus a gold flash when exhausted. Gorō/Mizuchi/Ōzeki/Kage have maxImbalance 4-5 (EnemyArchetypes.cs:122, 204), so against bosses parry progress is invisible.
issues.fix: Add a posture pip row to the boss bar: right-aligned above the stroke, maxImbalance diamonds 20 px, gold when filled and (70,66,74) when empty, labelled 'Postura' 22pt. On each new pip: scale pop 1.4->1.0 over 0.15 s plus a gold spark. When exhausted, the pips flash white-gold at 8 Hz and the bar edge glows gold. See mock_boss.png.

issues.title: Menu/pause button selection is invisible (keyboard/gamepad users can't see focus)
issues.evidence: UIFactory.cs:182-190: the button graphic is (0.1,0.09,0.12,0.85) with ColorTint normal (1,1,1,0.85) and selected (1,0.8,0.4). Resulting luma: normal 0.087, selected 0.076, so the selected button is DARKER and the label colour never changes. menu_new.png: 'Continuar' is selected and only barely browner.
issues.fix: Replace the Button visual with a NindoMenuItem component: Transition.None, implementing ISelectHandler/IDeselectHandler/IPointerEnterHandler. On select, a RibbonRed bar (sliced, height 64) wipes in left->right over 0.12 s easeOutCubic. A gold Kunai cursor (80x28) slides in from -20 px. The label goes from (0.78,0.74,0.66) to Paper with scale 1.0->1.06. Deselect reverses in 0.08 s. Acceptance: selected/unselected luma difference >= 0.25.

issues.title: Dragon shader: swims backwards, head is the most displaced part, horns and aura clipped by the quad
issues.evidence: NindoUISpirit.shader:115 `phase = canvasPos.x*_WaveFreq - _T*_WaveSpeed` makes crests travel toward +x (the head, which is on the right), while the comment says head->tail. A serpent's body wave runs head->tail. Amplitude `lerp(0.55,1.35,uv.x)*(1+_Rage*0.4)` reaches 0.03*1.35*1.18 = 0.048 uv (0.067 in rage), against measured sprite margins of top 6/248 = 2.4% and bottom 7/248 = 2.8% (Spirit_Frame.png). The aura samples up to 0.19 uv above the body. Result: horn tips and all flames above the dorsal hump are cut flat (lead capture shots/hud_rage.png, zoomed in phaseA/ui/zoom_hud_rage.png). The eye Image is fixed at DragonEye (0.918,0.64) while the head moves about ±0.045 uv = ±3.8 px (5.3 px in rage), so the eye drifts off the socket. step() edges alias at 560 px.
issues.fix: `phase = canvasPos.x*_WaveFreq + _T*_WaveSpeed`. Amplitude envelope over x: tail 1.25, 0.15->1.15, 0.75->0.9, 0.86->0.35, head 0.25. _WaveAmp 0.022, rage x1.25. Head motion becomes a C# nod (root rotation ±1.2° at 0.25 Hz) plus breathing scale 1.0<->1.012. Re-export the Spirit sprites with pad_y=40 (Tools/Unity/generate_assets.py crop_pair: separate pad_x=6 / pad_y=40, giving 1491x328) and recompute spiritFillArea. Spirit root 560x111 at SpiritPos (18,-98.5) keeps the body where it is. AA via `aa=fwidth(x)*1.5; inside=smoothstep(-aa,aa,edge-x)`. Ghost becomes desaturated gold (0.85,0.78,0.55) at 0.45 alpha (not a cream block).

issues.title: Bandana knot stretched 1.40x horizontally
issues.evidence: UIManager.HUD.cs:42 Health root is 560x92 and FillRect stretches Health_Frame.png (1476x339, aspect 4.354) to 6.087, a 1.398x horizontal stretch: the knot and tails look squashed (finisher_prompt2.png, zoom_hud_rage.png). The Spirit root 560x84 against 1491x248 is a 1.11x stretch.
issues.fix: Set Health_Frame meta spriteBorder (left 252, bottom 0, right 60, top 0) and healthFrame.type = Image.Type.Sliced; the knot keeps its aspect at any width. Fill RectTransform: full anchors, offsetMin.x = 173*92/339 = 47, offsetMax.x = -(1476-1399)*92/339 = -21. _TailEnd stays valid, since the left slice maps to uv 0..0.171. Verified in mock_hud_combat.png / zoom_mock_hud.png.

issues.title: All panels are flat rectangles, not 'Nindō'
issues.evidence: UIManager.Panels.cs:50 area-title 'Stroke' is a flat 1100x120 rect at 0.65 alpha. :57 tutorial is a flat Panel 980x120 at y=230. :63 dialogue is a flat 1300x230 with a 4 px gold top line: 1-2 lines of 36pt text leave about 50% of the box empty (intro1.png, sumo_dialog.png). :151-175 pause is a plain title, 4 flat buttons and a 24pt controls sentence with □○△. :177-215 options use flat sliders (white 15% track, 22x36 handle) and click-to-cycle buttons. :266-276 death is red 'Caíste' on black. :288-303 ending is plain text. UpdateBossBar draws a flat 1100x26 red bar with a 24pt subtitle that is barely legible (boss_goro.png).

issues.title: Enemy widgets pile up and overlap; markers are oversized; the finisher prompt pulses nervously
issues.evidence: finisher_prompt.png: three bars, pips, '防' and '[F] 処刑 Ejecutar' are all stacked over '¡DESEQUILIBRADO!' with no overlap avoidance (UIManager.cs:186-211). '!' alert is 90pt and danger/guard icons are 92/58 px (UIManager.cs:296-298), i.e. about the whole projected ninja (84-130 px). Finisher prompt scale is 1+0.06*sin(9t) (UIManager.cs:236), so it never rests.
issues.fix: Enemy widget: BossBarBack sliced 112x14 plus a crimson BossBarFill 104x10 with a paper ghost (hold 0.35 s, drain 0.6/s), and pip diamonds 12 px with an ink outline. Exhausted: pips flash, a gold rim appears and the text '¡DESEQUILIBRADO!' shows only the first 2 times (Save flag), afterwards an icon only. Declutter: sort widgets by screen y each frame and push overlapping rects up by the overlap (single pass). Marker sizes: IconAlert 56, IconUnblockable 64 (pulse 1.0-1.12 at 6 Hz until the hit), IconGuard 48, all anchored above the bar, never on the body. Finisher prompt: RibbonRed 300x60 + KeyCap glyph 46 px + IconFinisher 40 px + 'Ejecutar' 30pt. Pop 0.12 s (0.7->1.08->1.0), then breathe ±2.5% at 1 Hz. If unaffordable, grey ribbon, 'Falta Espíritu', and DenySpirit(cost) shows the missing amount on the dragon.

issues.title: Unblockable icon vs alert '!' are both exclamation marks (meaning and colour-blind risk)
issues.evidence: build_ui_art.py icon_danger is a starburst with a cut-out '!', tinted red (UIManager.cs:297). The alert is a yellow '!' text (UIManager.cs:296), so the only difference between 'noticed you' and 'can't parry, dash!' is red vs yellow, which is hard for protanopes. StoryDirector.cs:285 tutorial says '(estallido rojo)'.
issues.fix: IconUnblockable: crimson diamond with knocked-out '>>' chevrons (= dash), ink outline baked, 64 px (kit/IconUnblockable.png). It matches CombatTelegraphs DangerColor (1,0.16,0.1) and its jagged ring. Tutorial text: '¡Golpe imparable! Cuando aparece el rombo rojo no se puede desviar: presioná {Dash} para el DASH MÁGICO (usa Espíritu)', with the icon inline via <sprite> or shown next to the panel.

issues.title: Toasts: single centre slot over the playfield, overwrite each other, vague seal message
issues.evidence: UIManager.Panels.cs:78-81 / 318-323 use one TMP at +220 px above centre (over the enemies around Kaito). Combat callouts ('¡FILO DE IRA!' PlayerController.cs:372, 'Instante sombra' Combat.cs:354, '¡Parry perfecto!' StoryDirector.cs:313) and progress toasts share it and overwrite each other. 'Sello obtenido (n/3)' (StoryDirector.cs:470) doesn't say which seal. Boss enrage is a centre toast (Boss.cs:115).
issues.fix: (a) Combat callouts: world-anchored at Kaito's head +1.2 m and +60 px right, brush text 40pt gold/orange, pop 0.1 s, float up 30 px, fade 0.6 s. (b) Progress banners: top centre at y=-170 on a BrushSwash ink 900x110 with an icon (seal pictogram, IconBoss, ZoneGarden lantern for shrines), slide down 0.2 s, queue max 2, wait while the area title shows. Text: 'Sello de la Montaña / del Lago / del Bambú (n/3)'. (c) Boss enrage: boss bar flashes red, the subtitle swaps to '¡Enfurecido!' for 2 s, the name shakes 4 px; no centre toast.

issues.title: Area title collides with prompts/objective and uses a flat rect
issues.evidence: toast_title.png: title box at centre+260 (UIManager.Panels.cs:48). The '[E] Rezar en el santuario' prompt sits directly under the subtitle and '¡FILO DE IRA!' is pushed to +440. The objective stays visible at the same time.
issues.fix: Anchor top-centre, centre at 250 px from top (sits between the HUD band and Kaito, who is at screen centre). BrushSwash ink 1180x190 wipes left->right over 0.35 s easeOutCubic (Image.Filled). Hanko stamp 118 px thumps at 0.3 s (scale 1.8->1.0 over 0.12 s, rotate -6°, 8 ink specks). Title in Shippori 76pt with letter spacing 18->4 (existing). Gold BrushLine 560x16 draws at 0.6 s; subtitle 30pt gold at 0.8 s. Hold 2.4 s, then fade 0.6 s. Objective hidden while shown (mock_area_title.png).

issues.title: Controls shown as one dense text line; gamepad glyphs ambiguous
issues.evidence: UIManager.Panels.cs:167-175: 24pt grey sentence mixing keyboard and PS glyphs. InputReader.cs:245-250 returns '□ / X', '○ / B', '△ / Y' for every gamepad, so prompts read '[□ / X]'.
issues.fix: Device-specific glyphs: `Gamepad.current is DualShockGamepad` gives □ ○ △ ✕/L1 R1, otherwise X B Y A/LB RB. Draw each on a KeyCap (96x96 sliced, border 34) via UIFactory.KeyCap(parent, glyph, height). Pause controls card: one row per action (label 28pt + keycaps 44 px), for the current device, refreshed when UsingGamepad changes (mock_pause.png). Inline text in tutorials: parse tokens like {Attack} into `<mark=#F5EBD1E6 padding="10,10,4,4"><color=#0B0A0D> J </color></mark>` (no sprite asset needed).

issues.title: Options miss settings and use click-to-cycle buttons
issues.evidence: Settings.Rumble exists (Core/SaveSystem.cs:91) but is not in BuildOptions (UIManager.Panels.cs:177-215). Toggles cycle on click ('Cámara lenta', 'Pantalla completa', 'Calidad'), which is awkward with left/right on a gamepad.
issues.fix: Rows on InkCard: sliders (track BrushLine paper 25%, fill BrushLine gold, handle 22x22 red hanko square with ink outline, value % at right) and selectors '‹ value ›' (Kunai sprites mirrored) changed with left/right. Add 'Vibración' (Settings.Rumble) and 'Avisos de combate: Completos / Solo imparables / Ninguno', a new Settings.CombatAids int read by CombatTelegraphs and the markers.

issues.title: Low-health heartbeat out of sync with the screen vignette
issues.evidence: UIManager.HUD.cs:143 uses a lub-dub with a 0.86 s period. ScreenFX.cs vignette pulse is `0.5+0.5*sin(t*6)`, a 1.05 s sine. The two beats drift visibly.
issues.fix: Static UIBeat.Sample(t, hp01) (lub-dub, 70 bpm at 30% HP rising to 110 bpm at 5%) used by both the bandana (_Low, scale 1+0.035*beat) and ScreenFX vignette intensity.

issues.title: HUD icons are white silhouettes without the team's black outline (weak on snow)
issues.evidence: Resources/UI/Seal*.png and Icon*.png (build_ui_art.py) are white fill only, tinted at runtime. The team art (Health_Frame/Spirit_Frame) uses a ~6 px black outline. On bright snow (seal_taken.png, boss_goro.png) light icons and the objective text lose contrast; AddIconMarker compensates with an offset shadow copy.
issues.fix: Bake an ink outline (dilate mask 7 px at 128) under a white fill so tinting colours only the fill (kit/Zone*.png, Icon*.png). Add a soft ink 'scrim' (radial, alpha 0.35-0.45, blur 70 px) behind the top-left and top-right HUD clusters (see scrim() in mockups.py).

issues.title: Ember/eye/marker Images live in the main canvas: whole canvas rebatches every frame
issues.evidence: UIManager.HUD.cs:256-275 spawns up to 60 ember Images under spiritRoot; world markers move every frame; HUD, world and overlay share one Canvas (UIManager.cs Awake).
issues.fix: Add nested Canvas components on 'World' and on an 'HUDAnimated' child (dragon, embers, eye) so the static HUD and panels don't rebuild. Avoid per-frame string allocations (set objective/status text only on change).

plan:
"Tinta y Bandana" UI pass. Baseline is HEAD aba4a94. b656970 already removed all on-screen kanji and the orange bar; don't redo that.

0. BUGS FIRST
a) UIManager.HUD.cs:128 + UIManager.cs UpdateWorldMarkers:
   hideHud = InCutscene || PauseOpen || deathPanel.activeSelf || endPanel.activeSelf || DialogueOpen
   - fade hudGroup to 0 (dt*4)
   - world.SetActive(!hideHud)
   This fixes the ending bleed.
b) Lock-on: delete the torso diamond (UIManager.cs:119-123, 216-221). Replace with:
   - gold Kunai chevron 22x62, 70 px above the enemy widget
   - pop 0.15 s, bob ±4 px at 2 Hz, no spin
c) Boss posture pips in the boss bar (Boss.Imbalance / config.maxImbalance).
d) Menu focus: NindoMenuItem (UIFactory) with:
   - RibbonRed wipe 0.12 s
   - Kunai cursor
   - label colour change
   - Transition.None

1. ASSETS
Port phaseA/ui/ui_kit.py functions into Tools/UI/build_ui_art.py. Output to Resources/UI with sprite metas; borders are (l,b,r,t) for texture_meta(border=...).
- BrushSwash 1024x200, white, tint per use
- BrushLine 1024x28, white
- InkPanel 1024x256, ink, border (170,0,170,0)
- InkCard 512x512, border (128,128,128,128)
- RibbonRed 640x120, border (190,0,60,0)
- RibbonWhite: same, white fill for speaker tints
- KeyCap 96x96, border (34,34,34,34)
- Kunai 160x56
- PaperGrain 256 tile
- Icons, 128x128, two-tone with a baked ink outline:
  IconUnblockable, IconAlert, IconGuard, IconFinisher, IconBoss
- Zone pictograms, 128x128: ZoneHome, ZoneFields, ZoneForest, ZoneWall, ZoneGarden, ZoneDojo, ZoneMountain, ZoneLake, ZoneBamboo, ZoneMoon
- Hanko stamp 160x160: generate at runtime by compositing the pictogram on a red rough square, or bake 10 stamps
- BossBarBack 1400x72, border (80,0,80,0)
- BossBarFill 1400x72, white
- Optional: InkSplashRed 1024x512 (unused, the red slash looks better)

Tools/Unity/generate_assets.py:
- ui_sprites(): Spirit crop pad_y=40 (sprite 1491x328) and recompute spiritFillArea
- Health_Frame spriteBorder (252,0,60,0)
